company.name: Laminar
company.shortDescription: Low-code bespoke integration builder for solutions teams.
company.description:
Laminar is a low-code platform for solutions teams to build bespoke integrations faster with less engineering bottlenecks.

Laminar’s integration platform empowers Solutions teams to build data syncs to complex multi-step SaaS workflows through a low-code interface, eliminating engineering bottlenecks and coding headaches.

productsAndServices.description: A low-code platform for building, managing, and maintaining custom integrations across APIs, databases, and legacy systems.
productsAndServices.name: Laminar Integration Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI tool that helps generate business logic workflows between connected systems to accelerate integration development.
productsAndServices.name: Laminar AI-Assisted Workflow Generation

productsAndServices.description: Tools for ongoing management, error handling, monitoring, and versioning of integrations within a centralized platform.
productsAndServices.name: Laminar Integration Maintenance and Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: Flexible deployment choices including Laminar's cloud service or private cloud/on-premises installations to meet security and compliance needs.
productsAndServices.name: Laminar Deployment Options

productsAndServices.description: Tiered subscription offerings providing varying integration capacities, user seats, and support levels for different organizational needs.
productsAndServices.name: Laminar Subscription Plans
